description: Real Stripe integration: install Stripe SDK, rewrite createCheckoutSession to call stripe.checkout.sessions.create(), rewrite confirmCheckoutSession to validate the real session with client_reference_id ownership check and idempotency, fix getBillingStatus DB-unavailable fallbacks (both the !db branch returning plan:'pro' and the catch returning plan:'free'), and implement the Stripe webhook handler with signature verification and all five critical event types.
steps: Step 1 — Install Stripe SDK: cd /home/angeli/Desktop/luxcity/proptii-r1.1a/v2-backend && npm install stripe@^16.0.0. Confirm 'stripe' appears in v2-backend/package.json dependencies.

Step 2 — Add Stripe import and lazy getter in v2-backend/src/services/billing.service.ts: add 'import Stripe from "stripe";' after the existing imports. Add private _stripe field and a 'private get stripe()' getter that checks process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY — returns null with a warn log if unset, otherwise initialises 'new Stripe(key, { apiVersion: "2024-06-20" })' and caches in _stripe. Pattern matches existing 'private get db()' getter at lines 14-20.

Step 3 — Rewrite createCheckoutSession in v2-backend/src/services/billing.service.ts: remove the Firestore write entirely (current lines 133-143). If this.stripe is null: throw BadRequestException('Stripe is not configured') in production (process.env.NODE_ENV==='production' || !!process.env.RENDER_EXTERNAL_URL), otherwise return dev mock { sessionId:'cs_mock_dev', checkoutUrl:'/billing/confirmed?session_id=cs_mock_dev' }. In real mode: validate dto.planId against VALID_SELF_SERVICE_PLAN_IDS (defined in Step 6 as a static Set), call stripe.checkout.sessions.create() with mode:'subscription', customer_email, client_reference_id:userId, line_items:[{price:dto.priceId,quantity:1}], subscription_data with trial_period_days:30 when dto.trialEnabled, metadata:{planId,cycle,userId}, success_url using process.env.FRONTEND_URL||'http://localhost:5173' plus '/billing/confirmed?session_id={CHECKOUT_SESSION_ID}', cancel_url pointing to /pricing. Return { checkoutUrl: session.url, sessionId: session.id }.

Step 4 — Rewrite confirmCheckoutSession in v2-backend/src/services/billing.service.ts: add session ID format check (cs_mock_ rejected in production, must start with 'cs_'); in dev when sessionId starts with 'cs_mock_dev' fall through to existing Firestore-based logic; in real mode call this.stripe.checkout.sessions.retrieve(sessionId), assert session.client_reference_id===userId (ForbiddenException on mismatch), assert session.payment_status==='paid'||status==='complete'||(mode==='subscription'&&payment_status==='no_payment_required') (BadRequestException otherwise), check processedStripeEvents/{sessionId} in Firestore for idempotency (return cached data if exists), derive planId from session.metadata.planId, write subscription record using existing batch.set pattern, mark session consumed in processedStripeEvents/{sessionId}.

Step 5 — Fix getBillingStatus DB-unavailable fallbacks in v2-backend/src/services/billing.service.ts: replace the 'if (!db)' branch (currently lines 30-48) that returns plan:'pro' with 'throw new ServiceUnavailableException("Billing service temporarily unavailable")'. Replace the catch block (currently ~lines 97-116) that silently returns plan:'free' with a log + throw ServiceUnavailableException. Add ServiceUnavailableException, ForbiddenException, BadRequestException to the @nestjs/common import.

Step 6 — Add VALID_SELF_SERVICE_PLAN_IDS static Set to BillingService class (after logger declaration): Set containing 'free','renter_pro','buyer_pro','starter','landlord_pro','elite','independent','agent_pro'. Add planId validation as first statement in setPendingPlan: if (!BillingService.VALID_SELF_SERVICE_PLAN_IDS.has(planId)) throw new BadRequestException('Invalid plan ID').

Step 7 — Add raw body middleware for webhook in v2-backend/src/main.ts: inside bootstrap(), immediately BEFORE the 'app.use(json({ limit: "5mb" }))' line (~bottom of bootstrap), add: expressApp.use('/api/billing/webhook', require('express').raw({ type: 'application/json' })). The expressApp reference is 'app.getHttpAdapter().getInstance()' — already assigned to 'expressApp' earlier in bootstrap for the 'trust proxy' setting.

Step 8 — Add webhook endpoint to v2-backend/src/controllers/billing.controller.ts: add '@Post("webhook") @HttpCode(200) async stripeWebhook(@Req() req: any, @Headers("stripe-signature") signature: string)' — NO @UseGuards. Body is req.rawBody??req.body (Buffer). Calls billingService.handleWebhook(rawBody, signature). Add @Headers to the @nestjs/common import.

Step 9 — Implement handleWebhook and all private event handlers in v2-backend/src/services/billing.service.ts: handleWebhook checks STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET (throws BadRequestException in prod if not set; skips verification in dev), calls stripe.webhooks.constructEvent, checks isEventProcessed, calls dispatchWebhookEvent, marks event processed. Private handlers: onCheckoutSessionCompleted (calls grantSubscription with planId from metadata), onInvoicePaymentSucceeded (retrieves subscription, calls updateSubscriptionStatus status:active), onInvoicePaymentFailed (status:past_due), onSubscriptionUpdated (status/period/trial/cancelAtPeriodEnd), onSubscriptionDeleted (status:canceled, planId:free). Private helpers: isEventProcessed(eventId), markEventProcessed(eventId), grantSubscription(userId,planId,cycle,extra) using batch.set pattern matching existing confirmCheckoutSession code, updateSubscriptionStatus(userId,fields) using batch.set.

Step 10 — Update v2-backend/.env.example: add '# ─── Stripe ───────────────' section with STRIPE_SECRET_KEY=sk_test_your_stripe_secret_key_here, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET=whsec_your_webhook_signing_secret_here, and a note that FRONTEND_URL (already present) is also used for Stripe redirect URLs.
acceptance_criteria: npm install stripe@^16.0.0 runs successfully and stripe appears in v2-backend/package.json dependencies
createCheckoutSession no longer writes any Firestore record — it only calls stripe.checkout.sessions.create()
confirmCheckoutSession rejects cs_mock_ session IDs in production, verifies client_reference_id === userId, checks payment_status before writing entitlement
processedStripeEvents Firestore collection is used for idempotency in both confirmCheckoutSession and the webhook handler
getBillingStatus throws ServiceUnavailableException instead of returning plan:'pro' or plan:'free' on DB errors
POST /billing/webhook endpoint exists with no FirebaseAuthGuard, accepts raw body buffer, verifies Stripe signature
Webhook handles all five event types: checkout.session.completed, invoice.payment_succeeded, invoice.payment_failed, customer.subscription.updated, customer.subscription.deleted
cd v2-backend && npm test — all existing spec files pass
verification: cd /home/angeli/Desktop/luxcity/proptii-r1.1a/v2-backend && npm list stripe — prints stripe@16.x.x
cd /home/angeli/Desktop/luxcity/proptii-r1.1a/v2-backend && npm test — all tests pass
findings:
COMPLETED. Key details for FEAT-002/003/004:

1. Stripe SDK: stripe@16.12.0 installed in v2-backend/package.json dependencies.

2. Import added at top of billing.service.ts: 'import Stripe from "stripe";'. Private lazy getter 'private get stripe(): Stripe | null' at line ~52 returns null when STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is unset.

3. VALID_SELF_SERVICE_PLAN_IDS: static Set on BillingService class (line ~22). Values: free, renter_pro, buyer_pro, starter, landlord_pro, elite, independent, agent_pro. Used in both setPendingPlan and createCheckoutSession.

4. getBillingStatus: both the !db branch and the catch block now throw ServiceUnavailableException — no longer silently grants pro/free access.

5. confirmCheckoutSession: real Stripe path calls this.stripe.checkout.sessions.retrieve(sessionId). Ownership asserted with ForbiddenException. Idempotency via processedStripeEvents/{sessionId} Firestore collection. Dev mock path (_confirmFromFirestore) still works locally when sessionId starts with 'cs_mock_dev'.

6. Webhook: handleWebhook() is the public entry point. Raw body middleware registered in main.ts immediately before app.use(json()). POST /api/billing/webhook has no FirebaseAuthGuard. Five event types handled: checkout.session.completed, invoice.payment_succeeded, invoice.payment_failed, customer.subscription.updated, customer.subscription.deleted. Idempotency via processedStripeEvents/{eventId}.

7. Private helpers added to billing.service.ts: grantSubscription(), updateSubscriptionStatus(), isEventProcessed(), markEventProcessed(). These use the same batch.set pattern as the existing confirmCheckoutSession code.

8. NestJS exceptions imported: BadRequestException, ForbiddenException, ServiceUnavailableException (all from @nestjs/common).

9. .env.example updated with STRIPE_SECRET_KEY and STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET under '# ─── Stripe ───' section.

10. All 27 test files, 252 tests pass. Build exits 0.
